# Research image attribution

These terms apply to the research photographs and their derivatives, separately
from the MIT license for vividRGB code. Original files and crop coordinates are
recorded in the release manifest and per-image source JSON. Working windows are
crops of the originals; false-color maps and cluster maps are derived visualizations.
No provider endorsement is claimed. The materials are supplied under the upstream
licenses and their warranty disclaimers.

## Fungal Network Analysis

Mark Fricker, Carlos Aguilar-Trigueros, Lynne Boddy and Matthias Rillig (2021).
*Fungal Network Analysis – Dataset*. DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.5725751.
Provider: https://zenodo.org/records/5725751. License: CC BY 4.0,
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/; full legal text: `CC-BY-4.0.txt`.
Related study: Aguilar-Trigueros et al. (2022), *Network traits predict ecological
strategies in fungi*, https://doi.org/10.1038/s43705-021-00085-1.

## NeonTreeEvaluation

Ben Weinstein, Sergio Marconi and Ethan White (2022).
*Data for the NeonTreeEvaluation Benchmark*.
DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.5914554.
Provider: https://zenodo.org/records/5914554. License: CC BY 4.0,
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/; full legal text: `CC-BY-4.0.txt`.
The photographs are airborne imagery; the release retains source resolution and
native crop metadata.

## Coralscapes

Jonathan Sauder, Viktor Domazetoski, Guilhem Banc-Prandi, Gabriela Perna,
Anders Meibom and Devis Tuia (2025).
*The Coralscapes Dataset: Semantic Scene Understanding in Coral Reefs*,
https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20000.
Provider: https://huggingface.co/datasets/EPFL-ECEO/coralscapes.
License: Apache License 2.0, full text in `Apache-2.0.txt`.
The dataset card is retained as `coralscapes-dataset-card.md`; no separate root
LICENSE or NOTICE file was present in the provider tree checked on 6 October 2026.
Working photographs and class-reference windows are native crops; color and cluster
maps are derived visualizations.

## MOIN / KICS-Zert

Collection supplied by Masahiro Ryo / KICS-Zert. Public redistribution of these
photographs was explicitly authorized by the dataset owner for this release on
6 October 2026. This authorization is not an assertion that every photograph is
generally available under the software's MIT license.

## PMID2019

OUC Ocean Group, https://github.com/ouc-ocean-group/PMID2019.
Photographs are retrieved directly from the provider because no explicit image
redistribution license was verified. The release provides identifiers, checksums,
retrieval instructions and frozen non-RGB descriptors; it does not relicense or
republish the provider's RGB images.
